text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Before I sleep, I often light a stick of incense given to me by my grandmother.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The calming scent gently spreads through my whole room, contributing to a good night's rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Thanks to this, I am feeling refreshed and energized. Now, let's begin today's training!
